subject: Re: Renewal term + capacity bridge — proposed redlines and billing Qs
messages:
From: Lumos Data Legal <contracts@lumosdata.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & capacity increase — proposed redlines

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the call earlier — as discussed Lumos is planning to extend our Redwood subscription for a 24-month term starting 2028-01-01 and we need a capacity bridge for Q1 to cover a predictable ramp for a new product launch. We've attached our proposed redline to the MSA and a short order-form sketch (Lumos_Redline_v1.docx).

High-level asks:
- Push term to 24 months (2028-01-01 to 2029-12-31) with an option to terminate for convenience after 12 months with a 60-day notice.
- Add a capacity bridge clause: 50% guaranteed uplift for Q1 2028 with an automatic reversion to baseline unless Lumos gives 30-day notice to keep uplift.
- Conditional billing ramp: we want a quarterly true-up with credits for unused committed capacity (pro-rated monthly).
- Audit/usage reporting cadence: weekly token-level reports for launch period.

We flagged areas where we need Redwood's legal team to confirm compatibility with SLA credits and the way caching/overage is billed. Please confirm who on your side will take point on legal redlines, and whether Redwood can accept the proposed terminate-after-12-months convenience language.

Attachments: Lumos_Redline_v1.docx (MS Word redline)

Looking forward — Sara (Lumos)

--
Sara Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships, Lumos Data
contracts@lumosdata.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@lumosdata.com>

Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase — proposed redlines

Sara — thanks for sending this over and for the clear summary. Looping in Neha (CS) for the reporting / operational cadence and Karthik for legal redlines. Marissa I CCed for pricing alignment on the bridge commit.

Quick answers:
- We can support a 24-month term; the terminate-after-12-months convenience clause needs legal review — Karthik will outline options (we typically offer early-termination for certain enterprise amendments but we'd prefer a limited exit right tied to enterprise usage thresholds).
- Capacity bridge: technical implementation is fine (we automatically provision burst pools). Need to decide on how billing will be structured for the guaranteed uplift vs. burst usage.
- Weekly token-level reports for a 90-day launch window: we can provide that via the Console export and a secure S3 link.

Next steps: Karthik, can you review the attached Lumos_Redline_v1.docx and return a tracked draft plus a short redlineQ doc with the points you can't accept? Marissa — would you prepare a bridge pricing sketch we can share with Lumos this week? I'll host a 30-minute sync with Lumos + our legal + CS to get alignment.

Proposed sync: Thu 23 Sep 2027 10:00 AM PT (30m). If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Mina
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase — proposed redlines

Team — I reviewed Lumos_Redline_v1.docx and prepared a tracker (MSA_redline_tracker.csv). High level thoughts:

1) Term + termination-for-convenience after 12 months: Lumos' language is broad and would allow unilateral termination without financial consequence. We should counter with either (A) a termination fee equal to remaining committed revenue for 6 months, or (B) a narrow convenience termination right exercisable only if usage is below 40% of committed baseline for two consecutive billing cycles. Prefer (B) since it's usage-aligned and defensible.

2) Capacity bridge: Acceptable to codify a temporary guaranteed uplift, but billing terms must state guaranteed commit vs. burst usage and the automatic reversion mechanics. Proposed clause text included in tracker. Also propose a monthly true-up window (rather than quarterly) to reduce accounting friction for both parties.

3) Credits for unused commit: We cannot accept unconditional pro-rated credits that reduce the committed payment below cost of reserved capacity. Counter: unused committed capacity converts to a credit pool that Lumos can apply to overage or future months within the 6-month post-launch window.

4) Audit/data requests: We can provide weekly usage exports for 12 weeks; anything beyond that would be on a scheduled reporting cadence (monthly) to limit ops load.

I've attached the tracker and included inline suggested redline snippets. I'm ok to take point and send Lumos a tracked draft if Mina confirms alignment on (B) for termination and on monthly true-ups for the bridge.

Attachments: MSA_redline_tracker.csv

-Karthik
Associate General Counsel
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@lumosdata.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lumos Data Legal <contracts@lumosdata.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase — proposed redlines

Mina and team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from Lumos side after reviewing Karthik's notes: 

- Termination: Lumos' ask for a convenience termination is intended as a limited safety valve for an acquisition or major product-market pivot; we are open to (B) but need the usage threshold at 50% not 40%, and we prefer a 90-day measurement window rather than two monthly billing cycles.
- Monthly true-up: Lumos accepts monthly true-ups but asks that credits be cash-applicable (not just restricted to overage) if usage materially undershoots forecasts (>60% under baseline) for two consecutive months.
- Reporting: weekly export for the first 8 weeks would be sufficient; after that monthly is fine.

DocuSign note: Lumos will share an internal DocuSign for signatory approval once we have a tracked counter. For scheduling the sync — Thu 23 Sep 2027 10:00 AM PT works for Sara and Lumos legal.

Thanks,
Sara
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase — proposed redlines

Great, thanks everyone for the fast responses and for aligning on the sync. Quick recap and action items so we don't lose momentum: 

Recap: 
- Term: Redwood proposes option (B) — convenience termination only if usage < 45% of committed baseline for 90 days (compromise between 40% and requested 50%).
- Bridge billing: monthly true-ups; unused committed capacity converts to a credit pool usable against overage or future invoices (valid for 6 months). Lumos asked for cash-applicable credits at >60% under baseline for two consecutive months; Karthik flagged that as risky but will include conditional language in the tracker for discussion at the sync.
- Reporting: weekly exports for the first 8 weeks, then monthly.

Action items: 
- Karthik: finalize a tracked counter to Lumos by EOD Mon 2027-09-27 and include the draft convenience-termination compromise language + the alternative termination fee language. (attachment: MSA_redline_tracker.csv)
- Marissa: provide a bridge pricing sketch and the cost/baseline math by Mon 2027-09-27. Attach Updated_OrderForm_20270924.pdf to the reply.
- Neha: prepare runbook notes for CS to support weekly reporting and token-level exports (deliverable: cs-runbook-Lumos.pdf).
- Sara/Lumos: confirm signatory list after you circulate your internal DocuSign.

I'll send a calendar invite for Thu 23 Sep 2027 10:00 AM PT and include the tracker + updated order form. If anything changes on timing, reply-all.

Thanks,
Mina

Redwood Inference
